title: Bounded density ratio at a point with an approximate tangent space (Simon Remark 3.1.5(3))
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^{n+ℓ}, C ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} a set with Hⁿ(C) < ∞ (no measurability assumed), x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, and P a linear subspace that is the approximate tangent space of C at x (Simon Def. 3.1.4; Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x P). Then for every R > 0 there is Λ ∈ ℝ such that (rⁿ)⁻¹·Hⁿ(C ∩ B_{rR}(x)) ≤ Λ for all sufficiently small r > 0, i.e. eventually in the filter 𝓝[>] 0. Here B_{rR}(x) is the closed ball and Hⁿ(·) is taken as a real number (Measure.real).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (x : Amb n ℓ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ)), (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) C < ∞ → Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n C x P → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ Λ : ℝ, ∀ᶠ r in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), (r ^ n)⁻¹ * (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).real (C ∩ closedBall x (r * R)) ≤ Λ
